# NodeAccessibility

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Accessibility facts captured for a layout node, mirroring what the tagging pipeline would write into the PDF structure tree for the same element. Present only when the element exposes a role (implements `IRoleProvider`).

These are the element's intrinsic semantics, read directly off the element — they do not depend on `AccessibilityMode` being enabled, so the compliance evaluator can answer "would this be accessible?" for untagged documents too.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new NodeAccessibility()
```

## Properties

- [`Alt`](#alt): /Alt alternate text, when the element supplies non-empty alt text.
- [`Artifact`](#artifact): True when the element renders as an /Artifact (out of reading order).
- [`Decorative`](#decorative): Author explicitly marked the element decorative (artifact by intent).
- [`HeadingLevel`](#headinglevel): Heading level 1–6 for H1…H6 roles; null otherwise.
- [`ImageLike`](#imagelike): True when the element is image-like (a figure candidate).
- [`Role`](#role): Resolved PDF structure tag, e.g. "H1", "P", "Figure", "TH".
- [`Tagged`](#tagged): True when the element contributes real content to the structure tree.
